title: 群的同态和同态基本定理
Homomorphisms and the first isomorphism theorem
保持乘法，允许信息丢失
Preserve products, allow information loss
text: 同态保持群运算，不要求单射或满射。它自动保持单位元、逆元与整数幂。
A homomorphism preserves multiplication but need not be injective or surjective. It automatically preserves identity, inverses and integer powers.
example: Examples are reduction modulo n, the sign map Sₙ→{±1}, and determinant GLₙ(ℝ)→ℝ×.

title: 核与像
Kernel and image
text: 核记录被压成单位元的全部信息；像记录真正能到达的目标。核是 G 的正规子群，像是 K 的子群。
The kernel records what is collapsed to the identity; the image records which target elements are reached. The kernel is normal in G, and the image is a subgroup of K.
proof: φ(e)=e，且 a,b∈ker φ 时 φ(ab⁻¹)=e，所以核为子群。
φ(e)=e and φ(ab⁻¹)=e for a,b in the kernel, so the kernel is a subgroup.
若 n∈ker φ，则 φ(gng⁻¹)=φ(g)eφ(g)⁻¹=e，故核正规。
For n in the kernel, φ(gng⁻¹)=φ(g)eφ(g)⁻¹=e, proving normality.
像含 e，且 φ(a)φ(b)⁻¹=φ(ab⁻¹) 仍在像中，所以像也是子群。
The image contains e and is closed under xy⁻¹ because φ(a)φ(b)⁻¹=φ(ab⁻¹).

title: 纤维就是核的陪集
Fibers are cosets of the kernel
text: 同态不能区分 a、b，当且仅当它们相差一个核中的元素。因此非空纤维正是核的陪集；同态单射当且仅当核平凡。
A homomorphism identifies a and b exactly when they differ by a kernel element. Every nonempty fiber is a kernel coset; injectivity is equivalent to a trivial kernel.
proof: φ(a)=φ(b) ⇔ φ(b)⁻¹φ(a)=e ⇔ φ(b⁻¹a)=e。
Apply multiplication by φ(b)⁻¹ and the homomorphism law.
固定 b 后，这个条件等价于 a∈b ker φ，故纤维为陪集。
For fixed b, this is precisely a∈b ker φ, identifying the fiber.
若核只有 e，相同像迫使 a=b；若 φ 单射，φ(g)=φ(e) 当然只可能有 g=e。
A trivial kernel forces equal-image elements to agree; injectivity conversely forces the kernel to be trivial.

title: 同态基本定理
The first isomorphism theorem
text: 先把同态无法区分的元素合并成类，再映到像，就得到没有信息丢失的同构。目标是 im φ；只有 φ 满射时才能写成 K。
After identifying indistinguishable elements, the induced map to the image becomes an isomorphism. The target is im φ, which equals K only for a surjective map.
proof: 令 N=ker φ。核正规，所以 G/N 已是群。定义 f(gN)=φ(g)。
Put N=ker φ. It is normal, so G/N is a group. Define f(gN)=φ(g).
良定义：gN=hN ⇒ h⁻¹g∈N ⇒ φ(g)=φ(h)。
Well-definedness: equal cosets imply equal images.
保运算：f(gN·hN)=φ(gh)=φ(g)φ(h)。
Product preservation: f(ghN)=φ(gh)=φ(g)φ(h).
单射：φ(g)=φ(h) ⇒ h⁻¹g∈N ⇒ gN=hN。满射到 im φ 则由像的定义得到。
Injectivity follows from the fiber criterion. Surjectivity onto the image holds by definition.

title: 识别商群的三步法
Three steps for recognizing a quotient
text: 识别 G/N 时，先找一个自然同态，再证明其核恰为 N，最后确定像。不要只比较两边的阶。
To recognize G/N, construct a natural homomorphism, identify its kernel exactly, then determine its image. Equal orders alone are insufficient.
example: det:GLₙ(ℝ)→ℝ× 是满射（取 diag(t,1,…,1)），核为 SLₙ(ℝ)，故 GLₙ(ℝ)/SLₙ(ℝ)≅ℝ×。又如 n≥2 时 Sₙ/Aₙ≅C₂。
Determinant is onto ℝ× by diagonal matrices and has kernel SLₙ(ℝ). Hence GLₙ(ℝ)/SLₙ(ℝ)≅ℝ×. Likewise Sₙ/Aₙ≅C₂ for n≥2.

title: 商群中的子群来自哪里
Subgroups of a quotient
text: 设 N◁G。H↦H/N 与 B↦π⁻¹(B) 给出包含 N 的子群与商群子群之间的对应，并且保持包含关系及正规性。
For N normal in G, H↦H/N and inverse image under π give a correspondence between subgroups containing N and subgroups of G/N. Inclusion and normality are preserved.
proof: 同态的子群像、子群原像都是子群。π⁻¹(B) 包含 N，因为单位陪集属于 B。
Images and inverse images of subgroups are subgroups. The inverse image contains N.
若 H 包含 N，则 π⁻¹(π(H))=H：与 H 中元素同陪集的元素仍在 H 中；π(π⁻¹(B))=B 由 π 满射得到。
If H contains N, π⁻¹(π(H))=H. Surjectivity gives π(π⁻¹(B))=B.
gHg⁻¹⊆H 的像给出商群中的正规性；反过来，商群正规性取原像也给出 H 的正规性。
Apply π or inverse image to conjugate-closure conditions to obtain preservation of normality.

title: 再取商与自然映射
Taking a quotient twice
entries.tex: N\trianglelefteq G,\ M\trianglelefteq G,\ N\subseteq M\quad\Rightarrow\quad (G/N)/(M/N)\cong G/M
text: 若 N⊆M 都在 G 中正规，先模掉 N 再模掉 M/N，与直接模掉 M 得到相同结构。
If N⊆M are both normal in G, quotienting first by N and then by M/N gives the same structure as quotienting by M directly.
proof: 定义 f:G/N→G/M，gN↦gM。因 N⊆M，它良定义。
Define f(gN)=gM. Inclusion N⊆M makes it well-defined.
f 保乘法且满射，核是所有 g∈M 对应的陪集，即 M/N。
It preserves products, is surjective, and has kernel M/N.
对 f 使用同态基本定理即得结论。
Apply the first isomorphism theorem to f.
example: (ℤ/12ℤ)/⟨[4]⟩≅ℤ/4ℤ。这里 ⟨[4]⟩ 有 3 个元素，商群有 4 个元素。
(ℤ/12ℤ)/⟨[4]⟩≅ℤ/4ℤ. The subgroup has three elements and the quotient has four.

question: φ:ℤ→ℤ₆，[k] 的自然映射之核为？
What is the kernel of the natural map ℤ→ℤ₆?
reason: 核是所有被 6 整除的整数。
The kernel is the set of multiples of six.

question: 同态 φ 单射当且仅当？
A homomorphism φ is injective iff?
reason: Equal images are equivalent to b⁻¹a lying in the kernel.

question: 同态基本定理的正确结论是？
Which is the first isomorphism theorem?
reason: 只有 φ 满射时，像才等于整个目标群 K。
The image equals K only if φ is surjective.

question: 若 G 有 24 个元素且 |ker φ|=6，则 |im φ| 为？
If |G|=24 and |ker φ|=6, what is |im φ|?
reason: 每个非空纤维都是大小为 6 的核陪集，因此像有 24/6=4 个元素。
Each nonempty fiber has size six, so there are four image elements.

question: 证明：若 N◁G，商映射 π:G→G/N 满射且核恰为 N。
Prove the quotient map π:G→G/N is onto with kernel N.
reason: π(g)=gN；π(gh)=ghN=(gN)(hN)，所以保乘法。每个陪集都有代表，故满射。π(g)=N 当且仅当 g∈N，故核为 N。
The map g↦gN preserves products, reaches every coset, and sends g to the identity coset precisely when g∈N.

label: 补充定理
Supplementary theorem
correspondence.note: 子群对应定理在此由原像性质与同态基本定理补充证明。
